olivia_fin: FYI: incremental rollout for PRICE_REFRESH_V2 tomorrow 09:00 PT. 8% traffic. Must ensure grandfathering exclusions and invoice sanity checks. @mark_ops @chloe_billing @drew_cs pls ack.
mark_ops: Ack. We'll do a 90min canary with immediate 0% weight on trigger. Adding router guard to soft-fallback to LEGACY_RATE if meter_id not found.
chloe_billing: From billing: need vendor mapping + checksum, migration table with `grandfather_exempt`, and a dry-run invoice against the 14 exempt accounts + 30 PAYG. Requesting vendor CSV by EOD.
drew_cs: CS: those 14 enterprise accounts must be excluded. I uploaded list to Drive https://drive.redwood/drive/1Ab... If any exempt acct is charged we halt and notify customers.
vendor_luis: I'll upload CSV to s3://vendor-exports/price_refresh_v2_226789.csv and post sha256. Format: meter_id,sku,unit_cents,tier_info.
olivia_fin: Actions: 1) vendor_luis upload CSV+sha256 2) chloe build `migration_v2` + run simulated invoice 3) mark add parity metric `billing.meter_unmapped_rate` and PD alert 4) drew verify exempt list.
chloe_billing: Plan: ingest CSV -> create `migration_v2` with `grandfather_exempt` boolean and `source_sha256`. Run simulated invoice at 2x sample. Snippet: ```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(amount_cents) total FROM simulated_charges WHERE run_tag='prv2_canary' GROUP BY account_id;
```
mark_ops: I'll check mapping parity for the first 300 requests and emit `billing.meter_unmapped_rate`. If >0.25% in 15m, PD page and auto-roll back. Also will disable downstream invoice exports during canary.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing backlog: 16, avg latency 11s. Last full run: 2026-03-22T15:00Z.
vendor_luis: CSV uploaded s3://vendor-exports/price_refresh_v2_226789.csv sha256: e3b0c442... LMK if you want JSON.
chloe_billing: Imported mapping and added `grandfather_exempt` from Drive list. Running simulated invoice now; ETA ~90m. Will post results.
drew_cs: Verified exempt IDs. CS will hold go/no-go at 08:30 PT if simulated invoice shows zero NEW_RATE charges for exempt accounts.
olivia_fin: Rollback criteria: any exempt acct billed OR aggregate invoice delta >5% across canary cohort OR `billing.meter_unmapped_rate` >0.3% in first 15m. If any trigger -> 0% weight + ops review. I'll post final signoff 06:45 PT tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
